## Priority areas (Magento + Hyvä merged)

| Area | Priority | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Architecture (module / service-contract / DI) | ★★★★★ | Module structure quyết định change safety |
| Existing modules (plugin / preference / observer) | ★★★★★ | Plugin chain + preference quyết định override safety |
| Vendor docs — Magento DevDocs | ★★★★★ | API signature, DI config, upgrade notes đổi theo version |
| Business rules (pricing / tax / checkout / order) | ★★★★★ | Revenue-critical; rule ở `project-context/02` |
| Hyvä theme (Tailwind / Alpine convention) | ★★★★★ | Hyvä ≠ Luma; template/render pattern khác |
| ViewModel (ArgumentInterface) | ★★★★★ | Data-to-frontend contract; Hyvä compat |
| Tailwind v4 (CSS-first `@theme`/`@source`) | ★★★★★ | Purge miss = style hỏng; **KHÔNG tạo tailwind.config.js** |
| Alpine.js (x-data / x-init / reactivity) | ★★★★★ | Frontend behavior; không jQuery trong Hyvä |
| Vendor docs — Hyvä docs (docs.hyva.io) | ★★★★★ | Hyvä-specific pattern, version compat |
| Cache / indexer impact | ★★★★☆ | Stale price/content = incident |
| Database schema (EAV, indexes) | ★★★★☆ | Migration safety, query performance |
| Performance (minimal JS) | ★★★★☆ | Premise Hyvä = lightweight frontend |
| Magewire 1.13 (server-driven component) | ★★★★☆ | Interactive component pattern riêng |
| Community (Stack Exchange, blogs) | ★★☆☆☆ | Hint hữu ích; không override project convention hay devdocs |
| SEO | ★☆☆☆☆ | Hiếm khi relevant trừ khi là SEO feature |
